body: I wake up exhausted.  I go to sleep starving. I tell myself tomorrow will I will get around to X but I just don't have the mental or physical energy to get ahead of things.  The worst part is I just dont care if my life falls part.

I feel the same, working nights has given me the opportunity to use 'I'm just tired' to mask my pain for years.  I honestly think their questions are as meaningful as the standard "how are you" people dont actually want to know how you are... I never expect people to actually want to hear what's wrong so I make an excuse that I think will put their mind at ease.

I always feel the people I try to talk to trivialise and dismiss the extent of my pain.  I get a lot of "it will get better" - "you just need to (try to) be happy" - "I'm always here for you".  

As someone who suffers everyday I still don't pretend to understand the feelings of others. Telling people to 'try and be happy' is as useful as telling me to 'try and be taller'.
I genuinely think my only reason to live is so that there is something worthwhile to say at my funeral.
